presentation.summary: Copies Kometa's overlaid Plex posters and Plex collections into Silo after each Kometa run.
presentation.description_markdown: Mirrors movie and series posters (with Kometa overlays) and Plex collections into Silo. Season and episode artwork is never touched.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Create an admin API key in Silo and paste it into the settings.
2. Enter your Plex URL and token.
3. Set a webhook secret, then open the plugin's Status page to choose libraries and copy the webhook URL into Kometa's `webhooks: run_end:` setting.

capabilities.description: Syncs overlaid movie/series posters and collections from Plex into Silo. Normally triggered by Kometa's run_end webhook; run it manually here or give it a fallback schedule.
Receives Kometa's run_end webhook and serves posters to Silo during a sync.

fields.label: Plex URL
fields.description: Address Silo can reach Plex at, e.g. http://plex:32400

fields.label: Plex token
fields.description: Required. After saving, Silo shows this field empty; leave it empty to keep the saved token.

fields.label: Silo admin API key
fields.description: Required. An unscoped admin API key (starts with sa_), used to apply posters and manage collections. After saving, Silo shows this field empty; leave it empty to keep the saved key.

fields.label: Silo internal URL (optional)
fields.description: Only needed if auto-detection fails. Silo's own API address as Silo sees it, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080

fields.label: Webhook secret
fields.description: Required. Any long random string; Kometa sends it as ?secret= on the webhook URL. After saving, Silo shows this field empty; leave it empty to keep the saved secret.

fields.label: Delay after Kometa finishes (minutes)
fields.description: Wait this long after Kometa's run_end webhook before syncing.

fields.label: Only posters with Kometa overlays
fields.description: When on, only items Kometa labeled "Overlay" in Plex are synced.

fields.label: Delete Silo collections removed from Plex
fields.description: Only collections this plugin created are ever deleted.

fields.label: Dry run
fields.description: Log what would change without writing anything to Silo.
